name: hanssuite/hanscrypt
description: Framework-agnostic AES-256-GCM ID/URL obfuscation, with first-class Laravel and Symfony integrations and a generic PSR-11 factory.

suggest.illuminate/support: Required to use the Laravel service provider (HansCrypt\Integrations\Laravel\HansCryptServiceProvider).
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: Required to use the Symfony bundle (HansCrypt\Integrations\Symfony\HansCryptBundle).
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Required to use the Symfony bundle.
suggest.symfony/config: Required to use the Symfony bundle configuration.
suggest.psr/container: Required to use HansCrypt\Integrations\ContainerFactory with any PSR-11 container.
